conclusions: All twelve live model calls delivered complete JSON with known usage and no observed provider, retry, syntax or truncation failure.

Nine proposals were rejected with PHASE_BOUND and two with EXPRESSION_SHAPE by the existing equation compiler. These are valid-JSON/native-IR interface failures, not eleven mathematical reasoning failures or evidence of excessive authority restriction.

PHASE_BOUND covers phase shape, expression count and update count; EXPRESSION_SHAPE covers field shape, allowed identifiers, duplicate identifiers and operation membership. Only codes/digests were retained, so the exact malformed field/position cannot be reconstructed from this evidence.
One proposal executed and failed the independent objective oracle. This is a genuine mathematical/modeling failure on that candidate, distinct from the eleven unexecuted proposals.

Both two-call seed constructions failed. No host-authored fallback tool was supplied. Four context-only and four bound-invocation stages were intentionally blocked before any inference; their capability and efficiency are untested, not refuted.
The recompute baseline attempted four fresh parameter cases but only one was graded; none was accepted. No complete matched comparison, efficiency gain, tool reuse or recursion was demonstrated.
Physical construction is counted once; both reuse arms are charged the full failed construction cost. Recompute is not charged for seed construction it never receives.
